prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Tobias Reyne after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Restaurant ordering web app
client: Saffron Lane Kitchens
client_industry: food and beverage
start: 2023-02
end: 2023-05
engagement: fixed
stack:
- React
- Vite
- Firebase
- Stripe
- Workbox
implied_skills:
- offline-first
- service workers
built: An installable ordering app for 9 restaurants that keeps the menu and cart
  working on bad connections.
metrics:
- 22% of orders through the app within 2 months

The review is from: Saffron Lane Kitchens
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on technical quality; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "offline-first", "service workers".
text: Tobias did a great job on our restaurant ordering web app. He built a solid installable app that kept the menu and cart working even on poor connections, and the implementation with React, Vite, Firebase, Stripe, and Workbox was clean and reliable. We rolled it out across 9 restaurants, and within 2 months 22% of orders were coming through the app. Easy to work with and very strong technically.
